sentences.zh: 至于孝武，以諸侯王疆土過制，或替差失軌，而子弟為匹夫，輕重不相準，於是制詔御史：「諸侯王或欲推私恩分子弟邑者，令各條上，朕且臨定其號名。」

translations.literal: By Emperor Xiaowu, because the feudal kings' territories exceeded the regulations, some overstepped proper bounds and lost the law, while sons and younger brothers were commoners—the weighty and light were not proportionate. Therefore he issued an edict to the Imperial Censor: "If any feudal king wishes to extend private favor by dividing estates among sons and younger brothers, let each submit a separate memorial; I shall personally fix their titles and names."
translations.idiomatic: By the time of Emperor Xiaowu, the feudal kings' territories had exceeded the regulations; some had overstepped proper bounds and departed from the law, while their sons and younger brothers remained mere commoners—the weighty and light were not properly balanced. He therefore issued an edict to the Imperial Censor: "If any feudal king wishes to extend private favor by dividing estates among his sons and younger brothers, let each submit a separate memorial; I shall personally fix their titles and names."

translations.literal: From this, all collateral and younger lines were enfeoffed as marquises.
translations.idiomatic: From this time onward, all collateral lines and younger sons were enfeoffed as marquises.

sentences.zh: 《詩》云「文王孫子，本支百世」，信矣哉！
